heading: Tonight
text: Mostly cloudy. A few localized drizzle north or flurries over the higher terrain. Lows in the 30s, near 30 across the higher elevations north, near 40 around Burlington. Winds northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph, diminishing to light overnight.

heading: Tuesday
text: Mostly cloudy, with occasional sun south. Rain showers in northern NY, spreading east in the afternoon, mixing with snow around the border. Highs in the upper 40s to mid 50s, some mid 40s far north.Winds becoming southwest near 10 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph in the afternoon.

heading: Tuesday Night
text: Scattered to numerous showers from the Adirondacks and Rt. 2 north, south through the Green Mountains, mixing with snow then tapering off after midnight Partly cloudy in southern valleys. Lows in the 30s, a few 20s. Winds northwest near 10 mph.
